cross_difference_block.input: Candidate token states H_cand cross-attending to reference token states H_ref + per-token structural diff/hygiene tags

energy_head_E_omega.activation: GELU + final Softplus so E_omega(x, y_cand) >= 0
energy_head_E_omega.features: [z_ref, z_cand, z_cand - z_ref, |z_cand - z_ref|, z_ref * z_cand, delta_h_mean, delta_h_max, rule_emb(r_ref)]

shared_siamese_encoder_Phi_omega.input: Pair-aligned Form AST S-expression tokens (preserving _-prefixed unused-hygiene distinction, reference-anchored local identifier slots, newly introduced symbol slots, and low-bit numeric literal residues) up to max_seq_len=256

disjoint_filter_rules: 1. Exact 4-layer exclusion from FormJEPA-v1: exclude all 65 unique file paths in the 151-task ladder and all 40 paths in the H15 residual set.
2. Exclude any Form sharing a filename stem or numeric-stripped program slug (87 forbidden slugs) or conformance provenance with any evaluation task.
3. Exclude any Form sharing a primary state, actor, or module declaration identifier (62 forbidden identifiers) with any evaluation task.

4. Exclude any Form whose rce fmt nameless SHA-256 (shape_hash), canonical rce fmt SHA-256, or raw UTF-8 SHA-256 matches any original, mutant, or HEAD file of the 151 ladder or 40 H15 tasks (458 forbidden digests).
data_and_leakage_controls.inference_zero_checker_leakage: FormEBM-v2 computes E_omega(x, y_cand) purely from neural forward passes over (x, diag_of_x, y_cand) without invoking rce check on y_cand; rce check + W-MUT-1 is used strictly as the training-split label oracle and post-scoring evaluation oracle.
data_and_leakage_controls.split_rule: Exact deterministic FormJEPA-v1 split of the 1,387 disjoint valid Form shapes by int(shape_hash[:16], 16) % 10: 0..7 -> 1,106 train Forms, 8 -> 144 validation Forms, 9 -> 137 unseen held-out test Forms.

energy_and_telemetry.energy_separation_rule: est_j, reported_j, and measured_j are strictly separated and never summed.
energy_and_telemetry.host: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (32 logical CPUs, OMP_NUM_THREADS=10), Linux powercap intel-rapl:0 (package-0) and intel-rapl:0:0 (core) reported_j with pre/post idle drift Falsifier 6 audit

H11_unseen_test_5step_chains.source_forms: 137 unseen held-out test Form shapes (0 train/val/H14/H15 overlap)

H5_unseen_test_candidate_beams.source_forms: 137 unseen held-out test Form shapes (0 train/val/H14/H15 overlap)

falsifiers.F1_collapse: Post-training effective rank of z_ref or z_cand on validation pairs drops below 16 (of d=256) or mean coordinate std drops below 0.25.
falsifiers.F2_leakage: Any training or validation example shares a path, slug, primary declaration identifier, or shape_hash with the 137 test Forms, 151 ladder tasks, or 40 H15 residual tasks, or invokes rce check on candidate y_cand inside E_omega.
falsifiers.F3_h5_disproved: Held-out H5 AUROC of -E_omega(x, y_cand) across the N=200 unseen test candidate beams is <= 0.60.
falsifiers.F4_h11_not_supported: Strict 5-step edit-distance monotonicity rate on the N=100 unseen test corruption chains is < 80.0%.

objectives.contrastive_validity_margin_loss: max(0, m_val + E_omega(x, y^+) - E_omega(x, y^-)) with m_val = 1.0 over checker-verified train candidate beams
objectives.pairwise_edit_depth_ranking_loss: mean_{0 <= i < j <= 5} max(0, gamma * (j - i) + E_omega(y^(0), y^(i)) - E_omega(y^(0), y^(j))) with gamma = 0.50 over 5-step train corruption chains
